newsitem.title: USA: Mediq sells 1.2 mln Cardinal Health shrs.
newsitem.headline: Mediq sells 1.2 mln Cardinal Health shrs.

text.p: MEDIQ Inc Thursday said it sold 1,249,000 shares of Cardinal Health Inc at a net price of $60-7/8 per share or an aggregate of $76,033,000.
MEDIQ received 1,449,000 shares of Cardinal Health upon the sale of MEDIQ's interest in PCI Services on October 11, 1996.

MEDIQ, through its wholly owned subsidiaries, operates the largest movable critical care and life support medical equipment rental business in the United States, renting a wide variety of equipment for use by acute care hospitals, alternative care facilities, nursing homes and home health care companies.
